name: Koshmary tozhe plachut
source:
This mod is a direct continuation of [url=/v62961]Koshmar v Sovjonke[/url]. It will allow you to get acquainted with new characters, as well as learn the fate of the old ones.

Do you want romance? Force characters to step over themselves, walk under the arm, and kiss at sunset. Do you want blood and torture? Go to the wrong door in advance, jump into the bottomless pit, or open up to the heroes of the vein.

[Edited from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?l=english&id=944773802]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这个模组是 [url=/v62961]Koshmar v Sovjonke[/url] 的直接延续。它可以让你熟悉新角色，并了解旧角色的命运。

你想要浪漫吗？迫使角色跨过自己，夹着胳膊走，在日落时接吻。你想要鲜血和折磨吗？提前走错门，跳进无底洞，或者向血脉英雄敞开心扉。

[编辑自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?l=english&id=944773802]Steam[/url]]
